sources.title: Working with Dynamic Shapes
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: ONNX Runtime：execution provider圖分割
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：所有邊界形狀正確，超界可處理，MAX容量被驗證而非由OPT推測。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Boundary shapes pass, out-of-range inputs are handled, and MAX capacity is verified.
related.difference: 檢查每個算子的實際provider與張量駐留，找出碎裂分區的傳輸成本。
related.differenceEn: Inspect actual providers and tensor residency to identify fragmented-partition costs.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: NCHW張量bytes=N×C×H×W×s；高度寬度同時加倍，容量變4倍。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 batch1、C64、FP16=2 bytes，OPT128×128、MAX256×256；只算一個activation。 OPT容量1×64×128×128×2/2^20=2 MiB；workspace與其他activation另算。
總時間=子圖時間總和+每次跨裝置傳輸；支援算子多不等於最佳分區。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 三GPU子圖各1 ms，兩CPU子圖各2 ms，四次跨界各1.5 ms。 時間3×1+2×2+4×1.5=13 ms。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: NCHW bytes=NCHWs; doubling both spatial dimensions quadruples storage. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Batch1, C64, FP16 two bytes, OPT128², MAX256²; one activation only. OPT activation2 MiB; workspace and other activations are additional.

Total time sums subgraphs and cross-device transfers; more supported operators do not guarantee better partitioning. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Three GPU subgraphs1 ms each, two CPU subgraphs2 ms each, four crossings1.5 ms each. Time=3×1+2×2+4×1.5=13 ms.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MLPerf Power 觀念：每token能量與完整系統
related.titleEn: MLPerf Power principles: energy per token and system boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：所有邊界形狀正確，超界可處理，MAX容量被驗證而非由OPT推測。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Boundary shapes pass, out-of-range inputs are handled, and MAX capacity is verified.
related.difference: 使用同段時間的能量與有效輸出數，分開牆端功率、GPU讀值及額定TDP。
related.differenceEn: Use matched energy/output intervals, separating wall power, GPU telemetry and rated TDP.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: NCHW張量bytes=N×C×H×W×s；高度寬度同時加倍，容量變4倍。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 batch1、C64、FP16=2 bytes，OPT128×128、MAX256×256；只算一個activation。 OPT容量1×64×128×128×2/2^20=2 MiB；workspace與其他activation另算。
E=PavgΔt，e=E/N；對變動功率需積分，不用某一瞬間峰值乘整段時間。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 平均牆端功率600 W，60 s輸出12000有效token；包含主機、記憶體和冷卻於此量測邊界。 能量36000 J；每token36000/12000=3 J。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: NCHW bytes=NCHWs; doubling both spatial dimensions quadruples storage. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Batch1, C64, FP16 two bytes, OPT128², MAX256²; one activation only. OPT activation2 MiB; workspace and other activations are additional.

E=PavgΔt and e=E/N; varying power requires integration, not peak power times duration. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Average wall power600 W, 60 s, 12000 valid tokens; the selected boundary includes host, memory and local cooling. Energy36000 J; 3 J/token.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
